p: A team of three Japanese factory, construction and logistics workers, a man in a navy work uniform and white safety helmet holding a blank tablet, a woman in a light blue work jacket and white helmet holding a blank clipboard, and a man in a navy jacket and amber safety vest with a helmet, standing together and smiling with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face floating beside them.

A tired factory worker in a navy work uniform and white safety helmet searching through tall shelves of blank binders and blank machine manuals, scratching his head, with a large plain magnifying glass nearby.

A woman in a light blue work jacket and white safety helmet sitting at a site office desk, working together with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face on one blank document, a blank tablet showing plain bars beside them.
A busy male warehouse worker in a navy work uniform and helmet sitting at a desk, overwhelmed by stacks of blank paper forms, copying them into a blank laptop screen showing plain bars.

A male supervisor in a navy work jacket and white helmet walking toward a simple factory building, reading one tidy blank briefing sheet, while blank reports and a plain bar chart flow into the sheet held by a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face.

A female maintenance technician in a navy work uniform and white helmet standing beside a simple industrial machine, looking at a blank tablet, while a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face hands her an open blank manual.

A male engineer in a light blue work jacket at a desk, with large blank technical drawing sheets showing only plain geometric shapes, sorted from a messy pile into a neat row of blank cards by a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face.

A female construction worker in a navy work uniform and white helmet on a simple building interior site, tapping a blank smartphone, with plain arrows flowing from the phone to a blank table on a large screen.

A male factory worker in a navy work uniform and white helmet inspecting a simple machine with a blank tablet, taking a photo, with plain check marks in small circles and one amber warning circle without characters floating near the tablet.

A female quality inspector in a white lab coat and light blue cap at a workbench with a simple caliper and a small metal part, comparing a blank paper sheet with a blank screen of plain bars, with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face beside her.

Two factory workers, a man and a woman in navy work uniforms and white helmets, looking at a blank tablet together beside a simple yellow and navy striped safety barrier, with an amber plain triangle shape without characters and a plain shield shape.

A shift handover scene: a male worker in a navy work uniform and helmet and a female worker in a light blue work jacket and helmet standing face to face, both reading one blank sheet, a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face floating between them, a plain sun and a plain moon shape in the background.

A male warehouse worker in a navy work uniform and helmet beside simple shelves of plain cardboard boxes with one nearly empty shelf, looking at a blank tablet with a plain amber bell shape above it, a small hand cart nearby.

A female logistics clerk in a navy work jacket at a desk comparing a stack of blank invoices without characters against one blank contract sheet with a friendly plain white speech bubble character with a face, a simple delivery truck in the background.
